what: E-scooter towing records (OA-23057) in the listed Jongno-gu and Jung-gu dongs within 1 km of Gwanghwamun Gate, grouped by lot address
caveats: Addresses are placed in 300 / 500 / 1000 m bands from Gwanghwamun Gate by geocoding each lot address with VWorld at build time; no coordinates are stored (VWorld results may not be stored).
Records are past towing reports (DCLR_DT = report date), not current obstacles.
Districts changed how they log towing over the years; compare years inside one district only.

Only these dongs are geocoded: 세종로, 사직동, 내자동, 적선동, 통의동, 창성동, 효자동, 궁정동, 신교동, 청운동, 옥인동, 누상동, 누하동, 필운동, 체부동, 통인동, 내수동, 도렴동, 당주동, 신문로1가, 신문로2가, 수송동, 중학동, 송현동, 사간동, 소격동, 삼청동, 팔판동, 안국동, 화동, 견지동, 공평동, 청진동, 서린동, 종로1가, 관훈동, 경운동, 태평로1가, 무교동, 다동, 정동. Parts of the 1 km circle in other dongs have towing too but are not in this file.
Some report kinds are the reporter's own free text; those are counted as 기타(신고자 자유 기재).
source: Seoul Open Data Plaza OA-23057 (aiTbAutoKickboard), KOGL Type 1; distance bands from VWorld geocoding at build time (not stored)
